EASYWEATHER.Title: Easy Weather & Time
EASYWEATHER.Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can change the world's time and weather.
EASYWEATHER.CalendarApp.Title: Calendar
EASYWEATHER.Note.Heading: Notes
EASYWEATHER.WeatherApp.Title: Weather
EASYWEATHER.Toggle.NoParticles: This weather has no particle effect.
EASYWEATHER.Toggle.OverlayHint: Tint, clouds and precipitation drawn over the canvas.
EASYWEATHER.Toggle.SoundHint: Plays the ambient loop of this weather, if one is set.
EASYWEATHER.Editor.Title: Edit calendar
EASYWEATHER.Editor.Name: Name
EASYWEATHER.Editor.LoadPresetHint: This replaces everything in the editor with the chosen calendar. The world calendar only changes once you save.
EASYWEATHER.Editor.SeasonHint: A season runs from its start date until the next season begins. Month and day are counted from 0.
EASYWEATHER.Editor.LeapDays: Days in a leap year (0 = same)
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Climate.Name: Climate
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Climate.Hint: The climate the party is travelling in. It decides which weather is likely in each season.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.AutoRoll.Name: Roll weather on a new day
EASYWEATHER.Settings.AutoRoll.Hint: Rolls the weather automatically whenever the world clock reaches a new day.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Announce.Name: Announce the weather in chat
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Announce.Hint: Posts a small card whenever the weather changes.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.SceneEffects.Name: Particle effects
EASYWEATHER.Settings.SceneEffects.Hint: Where Foundry's own weather particles are applied.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Darkness.Name: Follow the day with the scene darkness
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Darkness.Hint: Adjusts the darkness level of the active scene to the time of day and the cloud cover. Changes the scene, so it affects everyone.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.PlayerPanel.Name: Show the panel to players
EASYWEATHER.Settings.PlayerPanel.Hint: Players see the date, the clock and the weather, but cannot change them.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Overlay.Name: Show the weather overlay
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Overlay.Hint: The tint, clouds and precipitation this module draws over the canvas on your screen.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.OverlayStrength.Hin: How strong the overlay is drawn on your screen, in percent.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Lightning.Name: Show lightning
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Lightning.Hint: Flashes on your screen during a thunderstorm.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Sound.Name: Play weather ambience
EASYWEATHER.Settings.Sound.Hint: Plays the ambient loop a weather state names, if one is set.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.TemperatureUnit.Hin: The unit temperatures are shown in on your screen.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.TimeFormat.Name: Time format
EASYWEATHER.Settings.TimeFormat.Hint: How the clock is shown on your screen.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.CalendarSource.Name: Calendar
EASYWEATHER.Settings.CalendarSource.Hint: Where the date comes from. Foundry's own world calendar is the one the GM sets in the world; this module's own calendar is edited in the calendar editor.
EASYWEATHER.Editor.FoundryModeHint: Months, weekdays, seasons and the length of a day come from the world calendar, so the date here is the date the world is set to. Only moons and daylight belong to this module.
EASYWEATHER.Editor.CustomMode: This world uses its own calendar
EASYWEATHER.Editor.CustomModeHint: The calendar below is this module's own. Foundry's world calendar is ignored while this is on.
EASYWEATHER.Editor.DaylightHint: How long a day is in the middle of the year, and how far the seasons pull it apart. This drives sunrise, sunset and the darkness that follows the day.
EASYWEATHER.Panel.DungeonOn: Dungeon mode is on: no sky, no day/night lighting, no weather rolls.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.DungeonMode.Name: Dungeon mode
EASYWEATHER.Settings.DungeonMode.Hint: Underground there is no sky. Holds back the visible weather, stops the scene darkness from following the day, and skips the weather roll at the start of a new day. The world keeps its weather, so stepping back outside picks it up again.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.PanelFade.Name: Fade the panel when not pointed at
EASYWEATHER.Settings.PanelFade.Hint: The panel sits quietly at low opacity and comes back to full as soon as the mouse is over it.
EASYWEATHER.Toggle.CloudsHint: Shadows cast on the ground by the cloud cover, drawn on the map itself.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.CloudMode.Name: Clouds
EASYWEATHER.Settings.CloudMode.Hint: What the cloud cover looks like on the canvas. On a map where a grid square covers real ground you look down on a cloud deck; on a battlemap you stand under it and only its shadows reach the floor.
EASYWEATHER.Settings.CloudMode.Auto: Decide from the map and the zoom
EASYWEATHER.Settings.CloudBreakthrough.H: The zoom at which the camera comes down through the cloud deck and the sky clears. Below it you look down on the clouds, above it you are under them. Only used when the clouds are decided from the map and the zoom.
